clip.quote: All stress is a compression of time. If you think you had two months to do a book report, you didn't feel stressed when it was announced, you felt stressed the night before when you didn't do it.
clip.why_clipworthy: This insight highlights the importance of managing time to reduce stress, a common issue for many agents.
clip.suggested_hook: Feeling overwhelmed by stress? Here's why managing your time is the key to relief.
